versions.content: Shared random timer for ProvidedServiceInstance ser- vice discovery If several ProvidedServiceInstance s reference the same SomeipSdServerServiceInstanceConfig in the role of sdServerTimerCon- fig and if it cannot be ensured that all ProvidedServiceInstance s are requested / released in the same point in time, then the timing behavior is handled per Pro- videdServiceInstance . The timing behavior shall be derived from the referenced SomeipSdServerServiceInstanceConfig for each referencing ProvidedSer- viceInstance .
